title: What a Godly Man Does With the Late-Night Scroll (It's Not a Willpower Problem)
caption:
A godly man's phone problem was never about willpower. It's about what he's actually starving for.

Name the ache before you fight the app. Put something in the gap before it opens. Take the restlessness to God instead of the glass.

This is the fight of your generation, not a phase you age out of. He's not asking for a clean record. He's asking you to keep fighting.

#fightthephone #christianmen #godlyman #digitaldiscipline #biblicalmanhood
